name: just

patches.old:
download() {
  url="$1"
  output="$2"

  args=()

  if [ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
    args+=(--header "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN")
  fi

  if command -v curl > /dev/null; then
    curl --proto =https --tlsv1.2 -sSfL ${args[@]+"${args[@]}"} "$url" -o"$output"
  else
    wget --https-only --secure-protocol=TLSv1_2 --quiet ${args[@]+"${args[@]}"} "$url" -O"$output"
  fi
}

command -v curl > /dev/null 2>&1 ||
  command -v wget > /dev/null 2>&1 ||
  err "need wget or curl (command not found)"

resources.checksum_source: locally-computed-pin from the HTTPS official release asset; not an independently authenticated publisher checksum

notes: Pins default tag to avoid GitHub latest API dependency; preserves stream-to-tar download semantics and native overwrite guard.
